content: The template <1>"{{name}}"</1> creates a new agent together with its skill sets and knowledge bases.

comment.text: Text of the Install this template? confirmation dialog for an agent template in the AI templates catalog. {{name}} is the template name, shown in bold with its quotes by <1></1>; installing creates a new agent together with its own skill sets (rooms of AI skills) and knowledge bases (rooms of files the chat searches).
